correctness.rationale: Exact tensor reduction of e^{itA} for Cartesian powers of K_q gives M_q(t)=aI+bJ, where a=(q-2+2cos(qt))/q. Simultaneous tensor eigenspaces have instantaneous eigenvalue a^j with multiplicity C(d,j)(q-1)^j. The period integral is the claimed exact Laurent constant term. Positivity follows for q>=3 from the a=0 multinomial coefficient contribution (q-2)^j; q=2 parity leaves only even indices, giving rank 2^(d-1). An independent character-pair count and a fresh 45-case exact verifier / 10-matrix numerical replay confirm normalization; no finite experiment substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete exact eigenspectrum for the Hamming association scheme at every alphabet size and dimension; it gives exact kernel dimensions and the sharp bipartite versus nonbinary positivity boundary, and addresses a named full-rank question for primitive distance-regular graphs in the Hamming subfamily. The full spectrum provides strength beyond a rank corollary and applies in arbitrarily high diameter. It is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a routine table recomputation.
